items.question: Under the UAE Federal Decree-Law on domestic workers, within how many days from the due date must a domestic worker's wages be paid?
items.gold: Within 10 days from the due date.
items.fact: Domestic worker wages must be paid within 10 days of due date.

items.question: What is the minimum paid annual leave entitlement for domestic workers under the UAE Federal Decree-Law on domestic workers?
items.gold: Paid annual leave of no less than 30 days.
items.fact: Domestic workers are entitled to at least 30 days paid annual leave.
